This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species<ref name="Rogue One" /> was distinguished by their masks known as [[Mazanti face covering]]s.<ref name="Outlaws" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> at least two members of this species, including [[Tunda Ress]], were present in [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] shortly before the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] the [[city]] in order to test the capabilities of their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jedha-Alien-G0021.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jedha Alien G0021 by Adam Brockbank]]
Tunda Ress' species first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Gareth Edwards]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> This species was designed by concept artist [[Adam Brockbank]], and concept art for it was titled Jedha Alien G0021.<ref name="Rogue One Art">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The "Wild Card DLC" of the [[2024]] video game ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' establishes that [[Human]]s are also capable of wearing Mazanti face coverings,<ref name="Outlaws" /> making subsequent appearances difficult to identify.<ref name="The Mandalorian">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}</ref> A [[2018]] card for [[Topps]]' [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] mobile application features two members of this species, titled "Chrome Faces – Rogue One – Shadow Portraits," referring to them both as "Chrome Faces."<ref name="Chrome Faces">{{SWCT|set=Rogue One - Shadow Portraits|cardname=Chrome Faces}}</ref>
